observations.why: Straightforward declarative delivered in neutral register — settled confidence about a decision, no intensifiers or urgency markers.
Bald '10x' multiplier and stacked benefits carry energized enthusiasm — high-arousal positive framing of the switch.
Structured recap redeploys the '10x' multiplier in a compressed benefits list — same energized-positive charge, now formatted for emphasis.
